Talent0_2Ability.name: Hot! Hot! Hot!
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat with a Flamethrower, triggers <buf ID=900064>[Peripheral Vision]</buf>. Prioritizes attacking other targets within range using the opposite Arm's Flamethrower, dealing <color=#F74848>20%</color> <buf ID=900065>[Flame DMG]</buf> to all targets in the path.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Hot! Hot! Hot!
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When initiating combat with a Flamethrower, triggers <buf ID=900064>[Peripheral Vision]</buf>. Prioritizes attacking other targets within range using the opposite Arm's Flamethrower, dealing <color=#F74848>20%</color> <buf ID=900065>[Flame DMG]</buf> to all targets in the path.
After initiating combat, inflicts <buf ID=2012512>[Joint Melt]</buf> on all targets hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700034.name: Within Our Grasp
700034.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if HP percentage is greater than or equal to the target's, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

201203.name: Press License
201203.describe: Gains <buf ID=2012032>[Ultrahot!]</buf> for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn, then can continue to move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles. Can attack after moving.

201204.name: Burning Spirit
201204.describe: Uses a Flamethrower to attack the main target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG and dealing <color=#F74848>20%</color> <buf ID=900065>[Flame DMG]</buf> to other targets in the path. If the main target is on allied Burning terrain, the terrain effect triggers once after combat.

201205.name: Link Meltdown
201205.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if a part is destroyed, disables the target's Retaliation ability and inflicts <buf ID=2012512>[Joint Melt]</buf> on the main target for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

201206.name: Thermal Burst
201206.describe: Uses a Flamethrower to attack the main target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.55x</color> DMG and dealing <color=#F74848>20%</color> <buf ID=900065>[Flame DMG]</buf> to other targets in the path. After combat, inflicts <buf ID=2012061>[Afterglow]</buf> on the main target.

201207.name: Headliner
201207.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat with a Flamethrower, AP Cost <color=#F74848>+1</color> and Damage Multiplier <color=#F74848>+0.2</color>.

201208.name: Wildfire
201208.describe: Uses two Flamethrowers to attack all targets within attack range, dealing <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. After combat, applies <terrian ID=4003081 /> to all tiles within range, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200031.name: Perfect Position 1
200031.SpecificEffects: Unlock the Assault Weapon's <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> ability. When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2
200034.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200035.name: Perfect Position 3
200035.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200036.name: Perfect Position 4
200036.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

201241.name: TCS 1
201241.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900064>[Peripheral Vision]</buf>, <buf ID=900065>[Flame DMG]</buf> dealt to all targets along the path is increased to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
Before actively attacking without having moved, can trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Only triggers if no other <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> effect is triggered this turn.

201244.name: TCS 2
201244.SpecificEffects: When on a Burning Terrain tile, reduces <buf ID=900072>[Percentage DMG]</buf> received by <color=#F74848>50%</color> and increases DMG Dealt by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

201245.name: TCS 3
201245.SpecificEffects: Attacks triggered by <buf ID=900064>[Peripheral Vision]</buf> also trigger the weapon skill effect of this attack.

201246.name: TCS 4
201246.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, if on allied terrain, AP Cost for the first attack this turn <color=#F74848>-1</color> (minimum <color=#F74848>1</color> AP).
